scientific_integrity.claim_scope: Two-dimensional generalized heterochaos baker maps; full vertical-fiber widths for Lebesgue-typical base coordinates. Near-critical limit fixes real drift eta and integer M >=2.
limitations: Classical path-reflection and Brownian maximum results are used, not claimed as original.
No invariant-law claim for entire fibers; no claim about two-point separation or correlations.
The near-critical crossover is pointwise for each fixed drift parameter.
Equivalences outside inspected literature remain a publication-priority risk.

title: Critical-window ensemble fiber collapse in generalized heterochaos baker maps
